summary.goal: Base layout with navigation, routing, and shared components for Forge UI. Establishes the application shell and core infrastructure.

acceptance_criteria.description: App shell with sidebar navigation matching Mission Control design
Routes: /forge (runs list), /forge/runs/:id (dashboard), /forge/runs/:id/timeline
Shared API client for Forge REST endpoints
SSE connection hook with auto-reconnect
Theme integration with Mission Control CSS variables
Loading and error state components
ForgeRunContext provider for shared run state across components

observations: SSE hook for real-time updates from Forge API
API client wraps fetch with auth and error handling
Context provider pattern for shared run state - SSE subscriptions managed at context level, not per-component

getRun(runId) returns { run: Run, tasks: Task[] }
pauseRun(runId) calls POST /runs/:id/pause
resumeRun(runId) calls POST /runs/:id/resume
cancelRun(runId) calls POST /runs/:id/cancel
TypeScript types for Run, Task, Artifact matching forge-domain schemas

acceptance_criteria.description: src/types/run.ts: RunStatus, Run interface matching forge-domain
src/types/task.ts: TaskStatus, Task, TaskAttempt interfaces
src/types/artifact.ts: ArtifactType, Artifact interface
src/types/gate.ts: GateStatus, Gate interface
src/types/question.ts: BlockingLevel, Question interface
src/types/index.ts re-exports all types

steps.title: Create SSE hook for run events
steps.description: Hook for subscribing to run SSE events with auto-reconnect

acceptance_criteria.description: useRunEvents(runId, enabled, onEvent) hook
Subscribes to GET /runs/:id/events SSE endpoint
Handles events: run_status_changed, task_status_changed, gate_reached, agent_progress, question_added, question_answered
Auto-reconnect on error (max 5 retries, 3s delay)
Returns { isConnected, error } state
Support for Last-Event-ID header on reconnection

specification.pattern_description: Copy usePlanEvents structure, adapt for Forge event types

steps.title: Create ForgeRunContext provider
steps.description: Context provider for shared run state across components. SSE subscriptions managed at context level.

acceptance_criteria.description: ForgeRunContext provides { activeRun, tasks, gates, questions, agents }
ForgeRunProvider wraps app and manages SSE subscription
useForgeRun() hook for consuming context in components
SSE subscription managed once at provider level, not per-component
Context updates on SSE events: run_status_changed, task_status_changed, gate_reached, agent_progress, question_added
Loading and error states exposed via context

architecture.pattern: React Context + useReducer for state management

specification.pattern_description: Similar context provider pattern with event-driven updates
